badge: A Brighter Future for Your Child
title: Your Foundation Statement
intro: Your Foundation Statement helps you organize your thoughts, identify what matters most, and set the stage for productive co-parenting discussions.

pillars.title: Clarify Your Goals
pillars.body: Identify your shared hopes for your child's well-being, stability, and future.

pillars.title: Focus on Your Child
pillars.body: Put your child's needs, interests, and daily life at the center of your co-parenting plan.

pillars.title: Set Values and Priorities
pillars.body: Outline the core values and principles that will guide your co-parenting decisions.

pillars.title: Create a Stronger Path Forward
pillars.body: Use your Foundation Statement to prepare for productive conversations and agreements.

fields.label: 1. Core hopes & goals for our child
fields.placeholder: What shared hopes do both parents have for your child's well-being and future?

fields.label: 2. Child needs & priorities
fields.placeholder: What are the essential emotional, educational, and medical priorities right now?

fields.label: 3. Agreed co-parenting principles & values
fields.placeholder: What rules or guidelines will govern respectful communication and joint decisions?

fields.label: 4. Personal commitments
fields.placeholder: What positive change will you commit to regardless of the other parent's actions?

footer_tags: Safer Children · Stronger Families · Healthier Tomorrows
disclaimer: A preparation resource for co-parenting discussions — not a legal agreement or court filing.
